name: Build a 6-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, export it to OpenQASM 2 with circuit_to_q
task_prompt: Build a 6-qubit GHZ circuit in pytket, export it to OpenQASM 2 with circuit_to_qasm_str, then re-import it and check the round trip preserves the statevector. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
